poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Set the bar over midfoot, grip just outside your legs, and brace.

poses.label: Lift
poses.description: Push through your feet and keep the bar close as it passes your knees.

poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Stand tall with long arms and the bar close to your thighs.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Send your hips back, then bend your knees to return the bar to the floor.

checks: Floor setup over midfoot, long arms, steady back, coordinated hip and knee extension and controlled floor return.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
The fixed camera and full-size plates can partially obscure the hands or bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
